Michael Grant: Michael Grant: The current picture is the copy and audience segments are drafted, and legal review has one unresolved consent question. We have the test cohort includes 240 opted-in administrators across three customer segments, and the signal I am watching is the success measure is completed onboarding within seven days, not email opens alone.
